sources.title_original: China shifting massive AI data center complexes to rural provinces to tap surplus energy — ‘Eastern Data, Western Computing’ strategy has Chinese tech giants Huawei and Tencent building AI infrastructure Guizhou
sources.summary: Chinese tech giants are putting up data centers in rural Chinese provinces with zero resistance. The abundance of land and energy in these areas allowed infrastructure to easily be built with limited issues, although some experts still question how much development they can bring to these areas.
sources.summary_zh: 中国科技巨头正在中国农村省份建立零阻力的数据中心。这些地区拥有丰富的土地和能源，可以轻松建设基础设施，但问题有限，尽管一些专家仍然质疑它们能为这些地区带来多少发展。

sources.summary: Two indie brands join together in a viral ad campaign asking people to pee on computers. Taylor Swift's brother-in-law, Jason Kelce, who co-owns one of the brands, stars in this humorous ad where he pees in a bottle and carries it to a post office to send to his AI data center of choice.
sources.summary_zh: 两个独立品牌联合发起一场病毒式广告活动，要求人们在电脑上小便。泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 的姐夫杰森·凯尔斯 (Jason Kelce) 是其中一个品牌的共同拥有者，他在这则幽默的广告中担任主角，他在瓶子里撒尿，然后将其带到邮局，然后发送到他选择的人工智能数据中心。

stories.title: Player builds working AI chatbot in vanilla Minecraft using 445K command blocks — clever approach shrank initial block count from over 1 million, requires no mods, plugins, or datapacks to work

sources.title_original: Player builds working AI chatbot in vanilla Minecraft using 445K command blocks — clever approach shrank initial block count from over 1 million, requires no mods, plugins, or datapacks to work
sources.summary: Building neural networks in Minecraft using redstone is a relatively common pursuit, but a clever creator has worked around the limitations of command blocks' available math operations to implement an LLM in just 445,782 blocks, down from over a million in the initial implementation.
sources.summary_zh: 在《我的世界》中使用红石构建神经网络是一种相对常见的追求，但聪明的创造者已经解决了命令块可用数学运算的限制，仅用 445,782 个块实现了 LLM，而最初实现时的数量超过一百万个。

stories.title: GitHub programmer ports playable Doom to DSLR camera with 3-inch TFT LCD display — Canon EOS 550D with open-source Magic Lantern firmware uses camera's button as controls, even plays sound

sources.title_original: GitHub programmer ports playable Doom to DSLR camera with 3-inch TFT LCD display — Canon EOS 550D with open-source Magic Lantern firmware uses camera's button as controls, even plays sound
sources.summary: A developer posted their Doom port for the Canon EOS 550D on GitHub. The game uses the Magic Lantern firmware add-on to run on the camera, and uses various camera buttons to play the game directly from the SD card.
sources.summary_zh: 一位开发人员在 GitHub 上发布了适用于 Canon EOS 550D 的 Doom 端口。该游戏使用Magic Lantern固件插件在相机上运行，​​并使用各种相机按钮直接从SD卡玩游戏。
